stages.title: The platinum
stages.body: Vice Got a Price! needs the other 54 trophies. There is no online list and no DLC requirement, so a single playthrough plus free-roam cleanup is enough. Keep a manual save at the start and end of each chapter: there is no mission replay.

stages.title: Prologue and Chapter 1 — Leonida proper
stages.body: Gone Fishing opens the story and its trophy lands on the first main mission. Chapter 1 ends with Paradise Lost. Two things here are easy to walk past: the balcony meditation at Jason's house, which only exists in this chapter, and the first vehicle scans, which quietly build toward Whip It Good and the 100% checklist.

stages.title: Chapter 2 — Vice City reach
stages.body: Chapter 2 ends with T**s Ass Drug Money. Coffee Break hands you partner free-roam, which is the gate on Hot Together, Retail Therapy and Personal Best; Breakfast Run carries its own trophy. Daily Driver installs the real-estate app behind Little Boxes, and Moses sets up On the Spot.

stages.title: Chapter 3 — the heist and the fences
stages.body: Vice City, Baby! closes Chapter 3 at The Cartel Heist. Credit Check unlocks the dye-pack jammer, so marked bills start counting toward Dime on the Dollar and the Little Cuba Payday Loans becomes robbable on foot for Bad Luck, I Guess. Yasmani's jewelry jobs open both Sneakthief and the three-shop run.

stages.title: Chapter 4 — airport and vaults
stages.body: Top Of The World, Ma, Family Matters, DWNFALL and Hi-Jacked all sit inside Chapter 4, which runs from Ocean Beach to Starting From Zero. That's Where The Money Is… arrives near its end and unlocks large-bank vaults, so Maximum Withdrawal, A Classic Blitz Play and usually Hot Together come with it.

stages.title: Chapter 5 — Savage Glory to the end
stages.body: Operation Savage Glory carries Snow Storm; the chapter then runs through Honest Abe, Unfinished Business, Protective Custody and The End of the Road. You Gotta Know When to Get Off is the finale. PowerPyx pins that trophy to Starting From Zero, the Chapter 4 closer, which disagrees with its own chapter list — treat the mission itself as the trigger and the trophy will arrive either way.

stages.title: Free-roam — the 100% checklist
stages.body: The checklist only becomes visible after the story, but work done earlier counts. It is deliberately forgiving: about 60% of the game, with 100 optional tasks, 39 gang operations, all bank jobs, all shooting ranges, all drone races and Bret's hunting decks, while collectibles are only partly required. Nothing here is missable.
stages.counts: 100% · 39 gang ops · 22 bank jobs · 42 drone races

stages.title: Cleanup — the odd jobs
stages.body: The remaining trophies are single actions rather than progress bars: a cocktail on Ocean Beach, a Banshee through a showroom window, a tank joyride at Mile Zero, a UFO at 2 a.m., a bowling alley score, ten pedestrians off a bike. Most unlock on the spot and none can be lost.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum arrives the moment the last of the other 54 trophies does. Nothing online and nothing behind DLC sits in the way, so one playthrough and the free-roam cleanup after the finale are enough.

steps.text: Work the roadmap in order: five chapters of story, then the 100% checklist, then the one-off actions. No second run is needed for any of them.
Save manually at the start and the end of each chapter. GTA VI has no mission replay, so a save file is the only way back into a story section you want to redo.
Leave the scoreboard trophies for last. By the time the checklist is done, most of them have completed themselves.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the first main mission, a Prologue-to-Chapter 1 handover that doubles as the game's controls tour. Finish it and the trophy is yours; there is no optional objective attached.

steps.text: Play the opening mission chain until Gone Fishing appears, then complete it. The trophy pops on the mission summary screen.
Expect it within the first hour, before the map really opens up. Skipping side content here costs nothing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Chapter 1 runs from Gone Fishing through the Brian and Donnie jobs to Recalibration, Tourist Trap, Home Sweet Home and Discharge Time. The trophy fires once the chapter's last mission closes out, which per PowerPyx happens as Chapter 2's opener, What's in the Bag?, begins.

steps.text: Follow the pink story icons through Chapter 1 and finish Discharge Time. The chapter trophy is handed out when Chapter 2 starts, not mid-chapter.
Before you close the chapter, do the balcony meditation at Jason's house. It is the only Chapter 1-exclusive trophy step in the game.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Chapter 2 covers the Vice City move: Pancake duties, Moses and the crawler, Breakfast Run, Coffee Break and the run to Checking Out. The chapter trophy appears when the next chapter opens with Welcome to Vice City.

steps.text: Push the main story through Checking Out (Move to Vice City). The trophy is granted as Chapter 3's first mission loads.
Use the chapter to knock out Breakfast Run's own trophy on the way; it sits inside this chapter's mission list.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Chapter 3 is the heist chapter: Yasmani's jewelry shops, Raul's crew, the Sinfrontera bank scoping and The Cartel Heist. PowerPyx puts the pop after Chapter 4's opening pair, Ocean Beach and Another Life.

steps.text: Finish The Cartel Heist, then keep playing into Chapter 4 until Ocean Beach and Another Life are done. The trophy settles there.
Do not skip Credit Check. It unlocks the dye-pack jammer that makes marked-bill laundering possible, and two trophies depend on that.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Chapter 4 is the longest stretch: the airport heist prep, Child's Play, Headliners, VCIA Takedown and the quiet aftermath. Its chapter trophy is tied to the close of Starting From Zero.

steps.text: Run the Chapter 4 story to Starting From Zero and finish it. That mission closes the chapter and hands over this trophy.
Watch for That's Where The Money Is… near the end of the chapter; it is the switch that turns on large bank vaults.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold is for the last story mission. PowerPyx lists the unlock against Starting From Zero (the Chapter 4 closer) while its own chapter table puts the finale in Chapter 5 — the trophy itself is simply the final mission, so play on until the credits roll and it will land.

steps.text: Finish the final mission of Chapter 5, after Protective Custody. The trophy is unmissable and needs no particular choices.
Expect the two sources to disagree on the exact mission name. Both agree the trophy is story-bound and cannot be failed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 mission where Jason checks in on Lucia and the pair's cover story gets a little more real. Complete it and the bronze is automatic.

steps.text: Play Chapter 2's story missions in order; Breakfast Run follows Daily Driver. Finish it and the trophy appears on the results screen.
Nothing in the mission is optional. There is no score, no medal and no alternate ending to worry about.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is the Chapter 3 centrepiece: the Sinfrontera National Bank scoping, the practice safe, the explosives prep and the job itself. It closes the chapter's main line.

steps.text: Complete every [The Cartel Heist] prep mission the story throws at you, then start the heist from the planning room and finish it.
The scoping missions are story-locked, so you cannot accidentally lose access to this trophy.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is the Chapter 4 rescue mission, unlocked after Fresh Evidence and played as Jason. Finishing it awards the bronze.

steps.text: Follow Chapter 4's story icons past Fresh Evidence and complete Child's Play (Rescue Rafa from Kidnappers).
This runs alongside the VCIA Takedown prep missions, so do not park the story in the middle of the airport preparation.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is the Chapter 4 launch-party mission, which sits between the airport prep and the heist itself. It plays as Jason helping with the event.

steps.text: Complete the Headliners mission in Chapter 4, right before VCIA Takedown. The trophy unlocks on completion.
Treat it as a checkpoint: once Headliners is done, only the airport heist and the chapter close remain.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is the airport heist that Chapter 4 spends a dozen prep missions setting up — the caterer truck, the surveillance, Kordell's crew and Andrea's delivery. Finish the heist for the bronze.

steps.text: Complete every [VCIA Takedown] prep mission first, then start the airport heist and see it through.
The heist is story-only and cannot be failed permanently; a botched attempt just restarts from a checkpoint.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 story mission, sitting after VC Baby and before the Honest Abe negotiations. Completing it awards the bronze.

steps.text: Play Chapter 5 through Bird in the Hand, Taking Liberties and Doggie Bag, then complete Operation Savage Glory.
The trophy is automatic. No choice in the mission changes whether it appears.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but anything you did during the story already counts. It is not a literal 100% of the game: PowerPyx measures it at roughly 60% of the content, with side quests mostly optional and collectibles only partly required.

steps.text: Finish the story first, then open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and let the checklist show you what is still greyed out.
Bank the tasks that require everything: all 39 gang operations, all 22 bank jobs, all shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races and Bret's 15 hunting decks.
Chip at the partial requirements early: 100 optional tasks, 200 scanned base-model vehicles, 100 studied animals, 300 stunts and 70 of 80 challenges.
Nothing on the checklist is missable, so a late start costs time and nothing else.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: There are 397 stunts in four flavours — 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps — and any 250 of them count. Pick the two cheapest categories and grind those rather than chasing variety.

steps.text: Mix categories freely; the trophy counts the total, not one type. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest per attempt.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or by name on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy if you are cleaning up the platinum anyway.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: The game counts nine activity types: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race of any kind, and performing a stunt. One of each is enough and most arrive on their own during the story.

steps.text: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities and hover each category to see which ones you have already touched.
Filter the map for Activities (the blue dumbbell icon) and knock out whatever is still at zero — a quick game of pool or a single stunt usually closes it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Two shooting ranges hold 12 challenges between them, worth 42 gold medals in total. Buy the $5 waiver from the clerk at each range to put the challenges on the map, then gold every one.

steps.text: Visit Griffin Shooting Range and Rodgers Ranch, talk to the clerk and pay the $5 waiver at each so all 12 challenges are marked.
Rent a weapon for $10 when you lack the required type; the rented guns are good enough for gold on every challenge.
Repeat runs raise Focus permanently, so a session here pays back later in Gunslinger.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Fourteen locations hold three drone races apiece, 42 in total. Only one win per location is needed for the trophy, though the 100% checklist wants all 42 finished and the first two beaten on par time to unlock the third.

steps.text: Find the blue Top Fun markers within about 100 metres and win a single race at each of the 14 locations.
Hold the stick forward the whole run and stay off the scenery; clipping a wall is what costs par time.
For the checklist, beat par on races one and two so the third unlocks, then simply finish it.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct races rather than the same circuit twenty times. The map holds 40 unique race locations, so there is plenty of slack — street races, race challenges and drone races all feed the counter.

steps.text: Unlock street racing through Yago's questline in Chapter 3, then work through the map's race markers.
Vary the venue each time: the trophy tracks separate races, so repeating a favourite does not advance it.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal texts you a fishing spot west of Key Lento once you have met him in Chapter 1. Turn up, take his challenge and land a bigger catch than he does.

steps.text: Finish Feng Shui (Meet Cal) in Chapter 1, then wait for Cal's text and the purple marker west of Key Lento.
Fish the spot and beat his catch. Cal's own questline does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so treat this as a standalone.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Four arcade cabinets exist: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. Three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; finishing every level of any one of them is enough.

steps.text: Use the controllers at Jason's place during Chapter 1 and pick whichever of the three home games you enjoy.
Play to the end of all its levels. Side challenges and high scores are not required — only the final stage.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's five-mission chain is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3 with a phone call, then a text with her Belville address. The chain ends with Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse.

steps.text: Play Chapter 3 as Lucia until Andy calls, then work through Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
Finish Puff Puff Pass for the trophy. Andy's chain does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, but it stays available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton runs the treasure-diving line out of Key Lento and wants seven shipwrecks cleared. He goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1, but Jason's call brings him back in Chapter 2 or 3, so the chain cannot be lost.

steps.text: Start with Island Dreams in Chapter 1, then dive the marked wrecks with the metal detector and hand the treasure in each time.
If Kenton vanishes after Chapter 1, call Brian as Jason in Chapter 2 and he will text you shortly after.
Clear all seven wrecks; track the count under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's mud-club chain unlocks after Coffee Break and is marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five missions end with Hometown Heroes, which carries the trophy.

steps.text: Run Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats and The Impaler, then finish Hometown Heroes.
Billy's line is not one of the Strangers & Freaks counters, so do not expect it to move that trophy's number.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Only some side chains count here. PowerPyx's count of confirmed contributors includes Kirk's skunk-ape line, Kyle's McKittrick Farm line, Yago's racing line and others; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy are explicitly excluded. Eight full strands are needed.

steps.text: Finish Kirk's three missions: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies and Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove.
Finish Kyle's three: Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle and Buddy?
Add Yago's racing chain and any other green-marked line from the same page until eight strands are complete.
Check the trophy counter in the trophy list before and after a final mission, since the game keeps no strand list of its own.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, the Chapter 3 mission that also hands you the key cloner. He wants 16 specific sports cars delivered to his garage in west Vice City.

steps.text: Scan high-end sports cars with WAiNK to see whether a car is on the list, then drive it to Randy's garage.
Check the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; a clean delivery pays more but condition does not gate the trophy.
Hunt around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach, where the wanted cars sit outside hotels and cruise the strip.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's line opens after Here, Kitty Kitty and is Jason-only. It starts with the purple synthetic-lab markers and ends with the Spin On This mission, which is what the trophy is named for.

steps.text: As Jason, work through Take Out Kitty Litter and destroy the marked synthetic labs around Vice City.
When Tyrone offers Spin On This, complete it. The chain remains available in free-roam if you leave it late.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: There are 18 meditations across 10 spots, and each spot can be done once with Jason and once with Lucia. The one genuinely missable meditation is on Jason's balcony during Chapter 1 and disappears once the chapter ends.

steps.text: After Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation lesson. This is the Chapter 1-only one.
Sweep the other nine spots with both characters once Coffee Break unlocks partner play, so each location counts as two.
Track the running total under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations; 15 of 18 is all the 100% checklist wants.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's hunting line opens for Jason after Coffee Break, starting with Veteran Hunted. He hands over the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle and then sends you after specific animals at the Target Decks.

steps.text: As Jason, answer Bret's text and complete Veteran Hunted in Lummox County to start the chain.
Work the purple hunting markers and the Target Decks under Map > Activities; all 15 decks are needed for the 100% checklist anyway.
PowerPyx notes the exact animal behind the trophy is still being confirmed, so clear the decks rather than gambling on one hunt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Eighteen card sets hold 480 cards between them. Three complete sets is the trophy; the 100% checklist asks for 15, which means roughly 372 unique cards at minimum.

steps.text: Prioritise the small sets. Backyard Wrestling has 12 cards and Delights Dancers 18, against 24 to 30 for the rest.
Sweep yellow phone boxes on walls and tool boxes on surfaces; indoor cards sit on shelves and desks.
Sell duplicates freely at a pawn shop — selling does not remove a card from the collection list.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK scans are outdoor objects flagged by the starburst icon in the phone app: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Any 100 from those sets counts, and 100 is also the checklist requirement.

steps.text: Walk with the WAiNK app out; the controller buzzes and a notification flags a scannable object nearby.
Ignore AHOL street art and the 1010 murals — they are their own collections and do not count toward the 100.
Verify the total under Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations before assuming you are done.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Eighty challenges are spread over eight categories of ten, all available from the start of the game. Fifty of them is the trophy and seventy satisfies the checklist, so ten can be skipped entirely.

steps.text: Open Progress > Challenges and hover each entry; a completed challenge shows a checkmark in the corner.
Clear the easy combat and criminal categories first — they overlap heavily with ordinary robberies and shootouts.
Leave this late. Most challenges finish themselves while you chase other trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: This needs free-roam with both characters, so Coffee Break in Chapter 2 is the gate. Reach four stars with your partner present, then get clear of the red heat zone — not merely the flashing search circle.

steps.text: Call your partner with the d-pad shortcut, then cause enough chaos to hit four stars.
Use a fast motorcycle through traffic; if a helicopter follows, shoot at it until it breaks off.
The train tunnel north of Ambrosia is the reliable escape — the cops lose you on the tracks and the helicopter loses sight.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Three robberies in a row while the police stay on you, with your partner along. The wanted level must never clear between shops, and the trophy can take half a minute after the third to appear.

steps.text: Wait until after Coffee Break, then call your partner and start at the Jewelry Stores in north Vice City once Yasmani's jewelry jobs have opened.
Carry armor, sticky bombs and something for healing, and loot a couple of items plus the back-room safe in each shop.
If it has not popped after the third, hit a fourth. The counter is forgiving but the delay is real.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scanning is enough — you never have to drive the thing. The WAiNK app unlocks in Chapter 1, so stand at a busy road and sweep every vehicle that passes.

steps.text: Hold the WAiNK shortcut and sweep passing traffic in Vice City; new models register as you scan them.
Check the count under Progress > Vehicles, which breaks discoveries down by category.
Boats and aircraft count too, so a marina or airfield is worth a detour.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and marks weak points, but only for a few seconds. Five enemies in one activation is the ask, and civilians or police reportedly do not count — use gang-operation criminals.

steps.text: Buff focus first by eating, drinking or washing at home, and take Adrenaline to stretch the window.
Line up five criminals at an illegal operation and use an accurate automatic rifle rather than a pistol.
Raise the focus stat by playing shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing; level four makes the trophy much easier.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal an airliner that is parked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International, taxi it to a runway and fly about a kilometre away. Planes parked out on the apron do not work.

steps.text: Go to departure terminal E3/E4, climb the stairs beside the bridge and enter the docked plane.
Get upstairs into the cockpit, reverse onto the airstrip, take off and fly clear of the airport.
Keep flying: the unlock is delayed until roughly one kilometre out, so do not land early to check.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhino is a military tank parked at Mile Zero Air Station, the island off the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Climb in, then use the cannon on someone.

steps.text: Reach Mile Zero Air Station; the tanks sit in the southern part of the base.
Drive in through the gate or take the stunt jump beside the south-east entrance, then board a tank.
Fire on enemies until the bronze appears.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: The Snap Gun is the tool that matters: it opens locked doors without tripping the alarm. Use it, take the safe code from the back-room note, loot the safe, then wipe the security footage and kill the alarm before you leave.

steps.text: Wait until the Snap Gun is in your inventory, then approach a jewelry store's locked rear door and choose the stealth option.
Read the note in the back room for the safe combination and open the safe.
Destroy the CCTV and disable the alarm before exiting; the trophy appears shortly after you leave the shop.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the location PowerPyx points at for this one.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Large bank vaults only exist after That's Where The Money Is… near the end of Chapter 4. There are eight of them, five are needed for the trophy, and all eight are needed for the checklist, so the trophy comes along for free.

steps.text: Complete That's Where The Money Is… to unlock large-bank robberies, then buy vault tips from Yasmani if the vans are not marked yet.
Tail a security van to its bank, slip in while the vault is open, and hand a bag to your partner — you cannot carry it all alone.
Escape the guaranteed four-star response on a fast bike, then switch vehicles so the search drops.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: The clean route is That's Where The Money Is…, where tailing the armored truck into the bank counts as the robbery. If you want it earlier, a sticky bomb on a truck's rear door works too, as long as you get out of the heat zone.

steps.text: Play That's Where The Money Is… and rob the vault it walks you into; that satisfies the truck requirement.
Alternatively, block a truck near a bank, stick a bomb on the back door and blow it, then escape the red radius.
The trophy only counts after you are clear of the heat, so keep moving until the screen settles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: This is map reveal, not foot travel: lift the black fog from every region. A plane is the quickest way to cover the state in a few passes.

steps.text: Borrow or buy a plane and fly a grid over the map, watching for remaining black patches.
Sweep the edges of the map last — the islands and the north-west corner are what usually stays fogged.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run 39 illegal operations between them, and the trophy needs one from each gang. Looting every key valuable in an operation is what marks it complete.

steps.text: Drive near yellow robbery icons to reveal them, and grab all key valuables — unique weapons, watches and the safe.
Check Progress > Gangs and hover each gang to see how many of its operations you have finished.
Clear the full set anyway if you are chasing the checklist; all 39 are a requirement there.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: A single drink does it. Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, order an Apple Martini and drink it standing at the bar rather than walking off with it.

steps.text: Travel to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it beside the bar. The trophy checks position, so do not wander off mid-glass.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: One specific car counts: the blue Banshee in the showroom in south Vice City. You need the key cloner from Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS before you can take it, then you drive it straight through the glass.

steps.text: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3 to get the key cloner.
Hack the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom, then accelerate through the window.
Keep driving down the street; the unlock is deliberately delayed and will not appear in the showroom.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is an illegal operation with three key valuables: a luxury watch, a unique shotgun and a safe that needs sticky bombs. Take all three and escape, and the bronze is yours.

steps.text: Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation before you go; the safe will not open without them.
During Chapter 2's Hit Kingpin Bowling, take the watch from the south-east office and the shotgun from the north-east table.
Blow the safe in the north-east hallway, then leave and shake the police before expecting the trophy.
A missed item is not fatal: the robbery respawns after a long wait and you can finish the leftovers then.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Both Jason and Lucia need maximum strength at the same time. Work out together after Coffee Break: one character trains while the other's bar fills alongside, so every gym visit counts twice.

steps.text: Wait for Coffee Break in Chapter 2, which unlocks switching between the pair.
Call your partner and go to a fitness club together — filter the map for Activities to find one.
Check the strength heart icon under the character menu until both are capped; home workouts work after the story too.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Five hundred actions that shift your criminal profile. Almost anything violent, sneaky or generous counts, so this arrives while you work on other things; the trophy screen shows the running total.

steps.text: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications so you can see the demon icon tick.
Let it come naturally through robberies and shootouts, and only farm it at the end if it is still short.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Robbing the Little Cuba Payday Loans a second time as Lucia and then leaving on foot. The first robbery is the Prologue; this is the rerun, and driving away does not count.

steps.text: Wait for Credit Check in Chapter 3, which unlocks Payday Loans robberies and the dye-pack jammer.
Go to the Little Cuba branch alone as Lucia, take out security and clear all three cash drawers.
Run. The unlock is delayed until you are clear of the search area and far enough away on foot.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A UFO easter egg on the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, after 2 a.m. and solo. The spawn is not guaranteed, so a blinking car at the roadside is your cue to try.

steps.text: Come alone, at night, after 2 a.m., to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel.
If a blinking car is parked there, follow the path into the woods toward the blue light.
Talk to the woman the UFO drops, agree to help, and walk her back to the car.
No car means no event this visit: drive away and return until it spawns.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Ten pedestrians kicked from a moving bike inside sixty seconds. Crowds are the whole trick: Ocean Beach and central Vice City have enough people to chain the hits.

steps.text: Take any motorcycle into a crowded stretch of Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Swing the melee attack while riding and keep the run under a minute for ten hits.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from bank and Payday Loans robberies, and the dye-pack jammer from Credit Check is what lets you launder them. A fence takes the cash; Yasmani in Vice City pays best, and the total is cumulative.

steps.text: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 so the dye-pack jammer is unlocked.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then hand the marked bills to a fence. Yasmani gives the best rate.
Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 each, so two or three good runs clear the $250,000.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A hundred thousand spent anywhere the game counts as a shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way to burn money because the price tags run high.

steps.text: Spend across categories rather than one store: mod shops, Ammu-Nations, clothing, footwear, salons, tattoo studios and electronics all count.
Fund it from robberies; a single large vault can cover most of the total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Twelve garages exist, but only the eight purchasable ones count, and together they cost $160,000. The Vice City Real Estate app appears shortly after Daily Driver in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 and wait for the real-estate app notification on your phone.
Buy all eight. They range from Mitchell Auto Center at $4,000 to Bonita Court at $34,000.
Ignore the four story garages; they are not part of the trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Scooter Bros installs after Moses in Chapter 2, and each garage you own adds parking slots. Drive stolen cars to Moses in Port Gellhorn and register them — ten in total.

steps.text: Complete Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) in Chapter 2 to install the app.
Buy garages first, since each one adds at least one slot you can register into.
Take a stolen car to Moses's garage in Port Gellhorn and use Respray, then Register. Cheap low-end cars keep the fees down.
